Halo. A science-fiction first-person shooter franchise launched by Bungie for Xbox in 2001, it features the super-soldier Master Chief aboard massive ring-world Halo installations. Known for expansive sci-fi worldbuilding, cooperative campaign design, and competitive multiplayer innovation, it became Xbox's defining franchise and influenced a generation of console shooters. Halo debuted in 2001 as an Xbox exclusive with Combat Evolved, establishing the franchise's core identity. Master Chief is a genetically modified SPARTAN soldier aboard the orbital megastructure Halo, a Forerunner superweapon designed to exterminate all sentient life in the galaxy. The Halo rings themselves are ancient alien installations created by a precursor species called the Forerunners, built to contain and annihilate the parasitic Flood. Humanity's discovery of their purpose becomes the narrative thrust throughout the series.

The franchise introduced the rechargeable shield system where overcharging shields depletes health, and weapons swapping between alien Covenant and human UNSC arms, fundamentally shaping console FPS balance and feel. Halo 2 in 2004 and Halo 3 in 2007 dominated Xbox Live online multiplayer. Halo 3 introduced Forge Mode, a map editor, and Theater, which lets players record and rewatch gameplay, influencing user-generated content in games everywhere. The franchise shifted direction with Halo 4 in 2012 under 343 Industries, emphasizing lore with characters like the Didact and the Created, introducing Spartan cosmetics, and implementing battle pass systems, particularly in Halo Infinite. The expanded universe includes Halo: Reach in 2010, chronicling the doomed planet Reach and the fall of the Spartans. A 2022 TV adaptation recontextualizes canon while novels and comics elaborate the lore further. Halo Infinite in 2021 returned to a live-service free-to-play multiplayer model with mixed reception, though a Legendary-difficulty campaign revisited core themes. Bungie originally developed the franchise, but their split from Microsoft in 2007 led them to create Destiny. Microsoft publishes Halo as its flagship franchise ambassador on Xbox, innovating console FPS design and online multiplayer culture.
